frame.batting: Side view — full body + stumps in frame
frame.bowling: Side view — full run-up path in frame
frame.fielding: Front view — room to move either direction
frame.keeping: Side view — crouch + stumps in frame

batting: Prop the phone at hip height, side-on to your stance
Fit your whole body and the stumps in frame
Play one shot per rep — tap stop right after
bowling: Prop the phone side-on covering your full run-up
Landmarks matter: plant foot, release, follow-through
fielding: Face the camera with room to move left and right
Stay low — the AI checks your body position
keeping: Prop the phone side-on showing you and the stumps
One take or stumping per rep

analysis.title: AI coaching
analysis.hint: Analyze your body position on this clip — runs on your phone, nothing is uploaded.
analysis.clean: Looking good — no major flags in this rep.

batting.stance: Check your stance width — aim for about shoulder width.
batting.head: Your head moves during the shot — keep it still and level.
batting.elbow: Lead elbow stays bent at contact — extend through the ball.
batting.knee: Very little knee bend in your load — sink a bit lower.

bowling.elbow: Your bowling arm bends noticeably through the action — keep it straight (rough 2D check).
bowling.release: Release point looks low — let go at the top of your arc.
bowling.brace: Front leg bends at delivery — a firmer brace adds pace.
bowling.head: Head drifts sideways in the action — keep it steady toward target.

fielding.ready: You're standing tall at the ready — get into a lower crouch.
fielding.bend: You bend from the waist, not the knees — sink lower to pick up.
fielding.throw: Throw stays close to the body — extend the arm for a fuller action.
fielding.over: You stay upright over the ball — get your head above the pickup.

keeping.crouch: Crouch is shallow — sit deeper so you can spring either way.
keeping.rise: You rise before the take — stay down until the ball arrives.
keeping.gloves: Gloves start high — set them low and rise with the ball.
